events.title: Quantum Chakras Event; An Immersive Healing Experience Through Live Music, Sound Bath, Guided Meditation, & Intuitive Energy Healing
events.description: Quantum Chakras An Immersive Healing Experience Through Live Music, Sound Bath, Guided Meditation, & Intuitive Energy Healing Imagine stepping into a space where every note, every vibration, and every moment has been intentionally designed to awaken your energy. Quantum Chakras blends live chamber music, immersive sound bath, guided meditation, chakra exploration, and quantum energy healing into a truly transformative experience. Throughout the evening, Eve Muir-Wilson’s guided quantum meditation and energy healing are seamlessly interwoven with Thor Bremer’s live chamber music and immersive sound baths. Each element enhances the others, weaving music, sound, guided meditation, and energy healing into one unified experience that supports deep relaxation, personal insight, energetic alignment, and transformation. As you journey through each chakra, you’ll be guided through moments of self-reflection to gain insight into the current state of your energy centers before embarking on a quantum journey to connect with the highest potential of each chakra. Together, sound, music, meditation, and energy healing create opportunities to release what no longer serves you, restore energetic balance, and awaken new possibilities for growth and well-being. Experience the profound intersection of sound, music, consciousness, and energy—and leave feeling renewed, aligned, inspired, and more deeply connected to your authentic self. Meet Your Guides Together, Eve and Thor bring their unique gifts into a seamless, immersive experience where meditation, music, sound, and energy healing become one transformative journey. Eve Muir-Wilson of Well Intentions Energy LLC is a metaphysical educator, intuitive energy practitioner, and creator of Eve’s Energy Alignment Method.™ With over 30 years in education and more than a decade of experience in energy healing, she blends guided meditation, intuitive energy work, and quantum consciousness practices to help others reconnect with balance, clarity, and their highest potential. https://www.wellintentionsenergy.com Thor Bremer is an interdisciplinary sound artist, composer, percussionist, and meditation teacher whose work explores the intersection of music, awareness, and contemplative practice. With degrees, certifications and decades of experience in music performance, game audio, sound design, and meditation instruction, Thor creates immersive experiences that blend live music, sound bath textures, guided reflection, and deep listening. His work invites audiences into states of relaxation, presence, and insight through carefully crafted sound and intentional musical space. Special Musical Guests Stephanie “Sly” Young is a violinist, violist, performer, and educator with a wide-ranging background in classical, chamber, rock, pop, and experimental music. She performs regularly with Fretless Strings, Bowtime, Nine Worlds Ensemble, Animal Farm, and Electric 5, and has shared the stage with artists and productions including Kansas, Rod Stewart, Trans-Siberian Orchestra, Distant Worlds: Music from Final Fantasy, Legend of Zelda: Symphony of the Goddesses, and Kygo. In addition to performing, she teaches violin, viola, and piano throughout the Chicago area. Molly Rife is a Chicago-based cellist, performer, and educator whose work spans classical, chamber, orchestral, pop, and experimental music. She has performed with ensembles including the Tucson Symphony Orchestra, Orchestra Iowa, the Illinois Symphony Orchestra, the New Philharmonic Orchestra, Cloudgate String Quartet, Bloom String Quartet, and Mucca Pazza. Molly has also performed with artists such as Smokey Robinson, RAYE, Kygo, Mono, Il Volo, Whitney, and Noname. In addition to performing, she teaches cello privately and at several Chicago-area music schools.

events.title: Keeper of the Cards: Robert
events.description: Robert – Intuitive Card Reader (Playing Card Readings) There is nothing complicated about the tools Robert uses—and that’s exactly what makes his work so extraordinary. With nothing more than a traditional deck of playing cards, Robert delivers readings that are clear, direct, and often astonishingly accurate. No elaborate spreads. No mystical theatrics. Just a method passed down through three generations, refined over time into something both simple and profoundly effective. What sets Robert apart is not just what he sees—it’s how he works. He asks no questions. You shuffle the cards. He begins to speak. From the moment the reading starts, information comes through with a natural flow—insight into what’s currently unfolding in your life, what’s shifting beneath the surface, and what is already set into motion. There’s no need to explain your situation or give background. In many ways, that’s part of the experience—watching as he describes details, dynamics, and possibilities with striking clarity, often before you’ve said a single word. Robert’s readings are known for their timing. Again and again, clients find that what he shares aligns with real-life events that unfold over the next 3 days, 3 weeks, and 3 months. It’s not about vague impressions or general advice—it’s about tangible, grounded insight that you can actually recognize as it begins to happen. Some people come in curious. Some come in skeptical. Almost all leave surprised. There’s something deeply compelling about hearing your path reflected back to you in a way that feels both immediate and predictive—where patterns become clear, decisions feel more grounded, and the unknown becomes just a little more understandable. His sessions are focused, efficient, and deeply personal. Whether you’re navigating change, seeking direction, or simply wanting to understand what’s ahead, Robert offers a perspective that is both practical and intuitive—rooted in real-time insight rather than guesswork. Many who sit with him return—not out of habit, but because they’ve seen the accuracy for themselves. This is a reading where you shuffle… and he talks. And what unfolds from there is something you’ll likely be thinking about long after you leave.
